title: ☕ STOP Saying "I Want a Latte"! (Say This Instead) #Shorts #EnglishLearning

subtitles.en:
, Alex, , if you walk into Starbucks, , what
is the first thing you say?
subtitles.zh: Alex，如果你走進星巴克，你開口第一句話會說什麼呢？

subtitles.en:
, Can I get a latte, please? , Why do you
ask?
subtitles.zh: 「請給我一杯拿鐵。」怎麼突然問這個？

subtitles.en:
, Really? , I always say: I want a latte. ,
That is what we learned in school!
subtitles.zh: 真的嗎？我都說「我想要一杯拿鐵」。學校不都是這樣教的嗎？

subtitles.en:
, Grammatically, it is fine. , But to a
barista, I want sounds like a command. , It
sounds like: Give me a latte right now!
subtitles.zh:
以文法來說沒錯，但對咖啡師而言，「我想要」聽起來像命令句。
就像是在說：「現在馬上給我一杯拿鐵！」

subtitles.en:
, Oh no! , Did they secretly roll their eyes
at me?
subtitles.zh: 天啊！他們該不會在心裡對我翻白眼吧？

subtitles.en:
, Probably! , Native speakers almost never
use I want when ordering.
subtitles.zh: 很有可能喔！母語人士在點餐時，幾乎不會用「我想要」這種說法。

subtitles.en: , Okay, save me! , What should I say instead?
subtitles.zh: 好吧，快救救我！那我到底該怎麼說才對呢？

subtitles.en:
, Two golden phrases. , Number one: Can I get
a latte, please?
subtitles.zh: 有兩個黃金句型。第一種是：「可以請給我一杯拿鐵嗎？」

subtitles.en:
, Can I get... , That sounds soft and polite.
, Got it! , What is number two?
subtitles.zh: 「可以請給我...」聽起來既委婉又客氣。我記住了！那第二種呢？

subtitles.en:
, Number two is super casual: , I will go
with a latte.
subtitles.zh: 第二種非常隨性道地，你可以說：「我選拿鐵。」

subtitles.en:
, I will go with... , Like making a decision
from the menu?
subtitles.zh: 「我選...」聽起來就像是在看著菜單做決定對吧？

subtitles.en:
, Exactly! , And for customizations, say: ,
Can I get that with oat milk? , Make it iced,
please!
subtitles.zh:
沒錯！如果想客製化調整，就說：「可以幫我換成燕麥奶嗎？
請幫我做成冰的！」

subtitles.en:
, Never I want oat milk! , That sounds so
much better!
subtitles.zh: 絕不說「我想要燕麥奶」！這樣講聽起來真的舒服多了！

subtitles.en:
, Now, here is a secret barista question: ,
Room for milk?
subtitles.zh: 再來，這是一個咖啡師常用的隱藏問題：「需要留空間加牛奶嗎？」

subtitles.en:
, Room means space, right? , If I want space
for milk, how do I answer?
subtitles.zh: 「Room」指的就是空間對吧？如果我需要留空間加牛奶，該怎麼回答呢？

subtitles.en:
, Just say: , Yes, leave a little room,
please. , And at restaurants, use: , I will
have the steak.
subtitles.zh:
只要說：「是的，請留一點空間。」而在一般餐廳點餐時，
你可以用：「我要一份牛排。」

subtitles.en:
, Golden rule: , Use Can I get, I will go
with, or I will have!
subtitles.zh:
黃金法則就是：多用「可以給我...」、「我選.
..」或是「我要...」這三個句型！

subtitles.en:
, What is your go-to coffee order? , Tell us
in the comments, , and subscribe for more
tips!
subtitles.zh:
大家平常點咖啡都怎麼說呢？在留言區告訴我們，
也別忘了訂閱學習更多實用技巧喔！
